Import library / Community resources

Facility AI scripts and automation

What each script does, when to use it, and how to get its import package.

Community imports: not live-tested. Check the stage, required modules and compatibility notes before importing. A published string is not a guarantee that it works in your version. Turbo Exec-dependent scripts are flagged as outdated.

← Import library overview

Power Plant layouts and yellowprint codesChallenge blueprint collectionsProgression and farming blueprintsResource farming by resource typeFacility AI scripts and automationAdditional script repositoriesHow to import blueprints, layouts and AIImport library sourcesImport coverage and known gaps

All Facility AI scripts require the AI functionality unlocked at MT4. Some additionally require particular building upgrades, software, modules, or later progression.

A. Bluecats automation packages

Source: Bluecats AI collection and import codes

ScriptWhat it doesWhen to use
WaterCatEnables/disables Headquarters software using configurable security thresholdsSwitching between different acceleration strategies
LazyCatSwitches among six saved software configurations using keyboard shortcuts 1–6Players frequently alternating between farming and progression
EarthCatChecks the Wave, Era, and Infinity highscores of every region/difficulty combination against specified targetsCompleting all 90 combinations for acceleration bonuses
bluekittiesAutomatically restarts runs after a configured time; can react to death and avoid resetting valuable accelerationLong, repetitive Tower Testing sessions
TrueCatDetermines the current region and difficulty, for use inside other scriptsBuilding region-aware automation; requires being at your highscore
DeluxeCatCombines restart timing, lag reduction, software control, Era/Infinity disabling, and multiple active-skill control methodsAdvanced Tower Testing automation

DeluxeCat is particularly worth investigating because it consolidates features that would otherwise require several separate scripts. Its source explains four skill-casting behaviors: constant skill use, delayed use, one-time use, and BORF-style skill spam.

Not all entries are standalone import strings: some are script packages or examples meant to be integrated into other scripts. Import the complete package where specified.

B. d0sboots' automation collection

Primary source: d0sboots — AI Scripts and Utilities

ScriptDescription and useCompatibility note
Simple SkillConstantly activates the first equipped active skill during Tower Testing. MT4+, useful for almost any active-skill blueprint.No Turbo Exec requirement stated
Factory AutomationCrafts Factory items, machines and producers in batches using keyboard controls.Requires supporting Factory skills
Auto Miner V3Automatically digs every available Mine tile upon entering the Mine.MT4+; can cause lag
Example MinerSimpler Mine automation example, useful for learning how Mine commands work.Educational and practical
Museum CombinerBuys and combines Power Stones according to a configured budget.Outdated: requires Turbo Exec
Auto AdventureAutomates actions for the Adventure minigame.Verify Adventure prerequisites
Adventure MapAssists with navigation in Adventure.Requires associated Adventure setup
Timed Task LoopingExecutes configurable periodic tasks, such as checking buildings or collecting production.MT4+; customize intervals
AutoclickerRapidly clicks the current mouse position, toggled with C.MT4+; don't combine with Turbo Exec
Factory Auto-TrasherRemoves unwanted items, especially from Mine Floor 2.Can work without Turbo Exec
Dust Up-tiererCrushes ores and converts dust toward configured tier ratios.MT4+; supports Factory workflows
Button Coordinate FinderIdentifies interface coordinates for developing mouse-based scripts.Primarily a script-development tool
AI BenchmarkerBenchmarks AI execution performance to identify script-speed limitations.Diagnostic utility
RNG ManipulationManipulates specific random-event behavior involving Rak's Curse.Specialized; version-dependent
Auto Era DisablerDisables Era powers as XP becomes available, following a configurable priority order.MT8+; useful for Era progression
Trading Post Crate SpamRepeatedly alternates trading and idle states to accumulate crates.Outdated: requires Turbo Exec

Compatibility warning: The developer of this repository explicitly states that Turbo Exec stopped working with the game's v1.0 release. Scripts requiring it should not be classified as operational in v1.0.15 without a verified replacement. That includes the listed Museum Combiner and Trading Post Crate Spam routines. Other scripts also need testing; lack of a stated Turbo Exec dependency is not proof of compatibility.
